title: OpenCRS 0.1 regulatory rule pack
description: A shared, versioned encoding of published rules (e.g. a state's roadside signage guidelines), referenced from a RuleSet as <name>@<version>.

version.description: The source document's edition, as YYYY-MM.

source_title.description: The source document's title, publisher and date.

status.description: unverified: taken from a summary or extract, not checked against the primary source. draft: every value checked against the primary source by the maintainer. reviewed: also independently reviewed, e.g. by the regulator or the OMA. A pack without a status is unverified.

status_note.description: What was checked, against what, and when.

citations.description: Where each encoded rule comes from in the source, keyed by its path in the pack, e.g. playback.min_dwell_s.

notes.description: What the pack leaves out, and anything a reader of the source should know.

creative.description: Rules checked when creative is validated.

playback.description: Rules the screen platform enforces. Validators report them as info.

min_dwell_s.description: A number, or bands chosen by the screen's placement.speed_kmh: a band applies from speed_kmh_from (inclusive) to speed_kmh_below (exclusive), and the first matching band wins.

failure_state.description: What the sign shows if the image or system fails: black (a black screen), blank (a blank screen of unstated colour), or the source's own words.

max_luminance_cd_m2.description: Maximum luminance by lighting period (day, twilight, night), then by the screen's placement.luminance_zone, with default for any zone. null means no limit.
